definitions.timezone: America/New_York DST-aware; CSV timestamps are five-minute bar opens.
definitions.source: Native explicit-contract ES CSVs; normalized source hash and coverage saved below. No CL/NQ observations copied.
definitions.event: 04:30 double breaks or both orange targets filled in03–05 or05–08:30, known by08:30. Direction is second side; same-bar ordering is excluded. Events may overlap dates; never pool as independent evidence.
definitions.coverage: Each outcome uses only complete19:30-to-checkpoint candles and its own future horizon. Short windows retain complete mornings on early-close dates; paired entry tests use the exact same dates per pair.
definitions.state: Known last completed close at checkpoint. OUTSIDE relevant frozen08:30 edge; RECLAIMED requires a strict post08:30 breach followed by close across edge; NEVER_BREACHED has no such breach. Prior close and executable checkpoint open are separate prices.
definitions.reference: Frozen high/low of[previous19:30,08:30), widthW. New extreme must exceed the entire19:30-to-checkpoint high/low. Normalized movement is move/W, with per-day AVR and price-percent also saved.
definitions.reversalTargets: Midpoint and opposite-edge touch rates only include targets still ahead in the reversal direction at checkpoint entry. Passing a target earlier is not a future hit.
definitions.control: Same market, family, qualification and forecast-fit minimum; exactly one side broken/touched on the same side as event second side. Match five nearest strictly earlier controls using four08:30-known normalized features:W/AVR,signed overnight move/W,closing range position,signed last-hour move/W. Features standardized using earlier candidates only. Five matches required; all five must have requested outcome coverage. Controls may be reused. This is descriptive matching, not a causal test.
definitions.uncertainty: Wilson95% intervals for rates. Paired and matched mean differences use999 calendar-month block bootstrap draws with fixed seed; CI unavailable with<10 dates or<5 months. Reused controls are not separately resampled, so matched intervals can understate uncertainty. No adjustment for multiple comparisons.
definitions.timing: Later-minus09:30 normalized return on identical dates. Common16:00 exit and equal60-minute exposures. Fixed-time endpoint returns, no transaction costs. Positive difference favours the later entry for that historical comparison.
definitions.brackets: Two symmetric equal target/stop distances:25% or50% of frozen overnightW, at checkpoint open; follow or fade event direction; exit by16:00. Scan candles chronologically. Open gaps resolve before high/low. Stop gaps incur actual opening loss; target fills conservatively at target. Same candle target+stop is unknown, with lower/upper bounds. Timeout marked to last completed close. Gross R has no fees/slippage and uses idealized checkpoints; optional2/4 total round-trip tick deductions are sensitivity assumptions, not actual observed costs; thresholds specified for this exploratory study, not optimized.
definitions.chronology: 2022–2024 versus2025–2026 and annual results are retrospective chronological sensitivity. All history has already been examined; neither period is an untouched out-of-sample validation. No fitted trading rule or chosen winner is deployed.
definitions.limits: OHLC alone cannot prove news/headline causation. Small orange samples, explored hypotheses, overlapping dates, control reuse and serial dependence limit reliability. No profitability or recommended entry claim.
